expected_dmg.note: counter placement (ignores weakness/resistance/damage-reduction); hits opponent Active only; probe: hand6->120HP, hand4->80HP
cost [0,0,0]=3 colorless; backup attacker, but Dudunsparce is mainly a draw body

early.until: no Alakazam(743) in play OR Alakazam has 0 Psychic-providing energy
early.on_plan: Abra(741) Active by T1; >=1 bench basic; a Psychic energy (id 5 or 19, NOT Enriching id13) on the Alakazam-line body; Alakazam(743)+Rare Candy(1079) OR Kadabra(742) assembled in hand via Dawn/Hilda/PokePad; hand growing, not being dumped
early.recovery: Dawn(1231)/Hilda(1225) to fetch missing evo pieces; Poffin(1086)/PokePad(1152) to secure basics; Night Stretcher(1097) if pieces already discarded

mid.until: Alakazam(743) Active with >=1 Psychic energy and hand_size >= target_HP/20
mid.on_plan: each turn: (1) make hand-reducing plays FIRST (bench/attach/rare-candy), (2) evolve Kadabra->Alakazam LAST so Psychic Draw's 3 cards sit in hand at attack, (3) optionally Boss's Orders(1182) to pull a KO-able/high-prize target, (4) Powerful Hand for >= active-target HP. Target hand_size at attack >= 8 (=160)
mid.recovery: if hand too small to KO, prefer holding cards / drawing net-positive (Hilda/Dawn/Dudunsparce) over attacking into a whiff

late.on_plan: chain a fresh Alakazam every turn (main body 140HP is OHKO'd back); recur KO'd Alakazam/Abra/energy with Night Stretcher(1097)/Lana's Aid(1184); fire Sacred Ash(1129) when deckCount<=8 and >=3 Pokemon in discard to dodge deckout; close 6 prizes
late.recovery: Sacred Ash to reset deckout clock; Lana's Aid mass-recovers the evo line + basic energy

hypotheses.claim: Powerful Hand has damage=0 in the card DB; a generic engine that ranks attacks by listed damage will value Alakazam's attack at 0 and either refuse to attack with it or prefer a weaker fixed-damage attacker (Land Crush 90, Super Psy Bolt 30), throttling the deck's only real win condition.
hypotheses.expect: play_rate[743_powerful_hand] should be the dominant attack (>0.7 of attack turns once online); if ~0, misfire confirmed
hypotheses.violation_symptom: スケール技が過小評価される
hypotheses.pattern: 実打点式(20*hand)を共有知覚 _expected_dmg に昇格

hypotheses.claim: Powerful Hand real damage = 20 * hand_size_at_attack. A generic 'attack when able' + 'develop board / play cards' policy dumps the hand to build board, then attacks with a small hand for trivial damage. Probe self-play fired Powerful Hand at hand sizes as low as 2-5 (=40-100).
hypotheses.expect: mean hand_size at Powerful Hand >= 8; fraction of PH attacks with hand<6 should be near 0
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 攻撃せず抱え込み/遅延 (逆: 撃ち急ぎで手札枯渇)
hypotheses.pattern: 手札温存則: Powerful Hand ターンは非必須プレイを止め、evolve/draw を最後に回して terminal hand を最大化

hypotheses.claim: Powerful Hand costs [5] = 1 PSYCHIC energy. Enriching Energy(13) provides only {C}(colorless) and does NOT satisfy the {P} requirement (probe: Alakazam with only Enriching shows energies=[0]). A generic 'attach best/any energy, treat energized body as loaded' policy can put Enriching on the Alakazam line and mark it装填済み though it can never fire Powerful Hand — a marnie-style 型死.
hypotheses.expect: Enriching(13) attach share onto the Alakazam line ~0; Enriching should feed Dunsparce/Dudunsparce (colorless) or be a pure draw-4 dump
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 型死ポケモンを装填扱い
hypotheses.pattern: 型対応の装填判定(数でなく型で装填を判定); Powerful Hand は Psychic(id5/19)必須

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders(1182) gust value must be computed from Powerful Hand's real formula, not its listed 0 damage. Correct target = a benched Pokemon we can KO this turn (HP <= 20*hand) with highest prize value, or a support piece we can remove; a 0-damage-keyed gust heuristic will mis-target or skip.
hypotheses.expect: gust chosen target should usually be finishable this turn (target_HP <= 20*hand) or a high-value support; not the tankiest wall
hypotheses.pattern: サイド期待値・実打点(20*hand)ベースの対象選択

hypotheses.claim: 4x Enhanced Hammer(1081) is a heavy anti-Special-Energy package that is DEAD against decks with no special energy. A generic 'play trainers' policy will burn it with no valid target (or hold it when a target exists).
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[1081] conditioned on opponent special-energy presence
hypotheses.expect: Enhanced Hammer fires only when opponent has >=1 Special Energy attached; play_rate ~0 vs all-basic-energy opponents
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 妨害カードの浪費/腐り
hypotheses.pattern: 相手盤面条件(特殊エネ有)に限定した発火

hypotheses.claim: Dudunsparce(66) Run Away Draw draws 3 but SHUFFLES ITSELF (and attached cards) back into the deck. Using it when the hand is already large is pure card-neutral churn that also deletes a 140-HP body/bench sitter and can undo energy investment. Generic 'draw when hand<=5' or 'use available ability' will fire it at the wrong times.
hypotheses.expect: Run Away Draw fires only when hand is small (<=4) AND the Dudunsparce is not a needed attacker/bench body with energy on it
hypotheses.violation_symptom: キーカードのプレイ率誤り
hypotheses.pattern: 手札枚数の汎用閾値でなく '手札<=N かつ 盤面上不要' の所持/盤面状態ベース発火

hypotheses.claim: The deck runs a very heavy draw stack (Alakazam draw3-on-evolve, Kadabra draw2, Dudunsparce draw3, Enriching draw4, plus 16 search cards). Probe self-play reached deckCount 0 in at least one game. Deckout is a real secondary loss condition; Sacred Ash(1129, 1 copy) is the only deck-refill.
hypotheses.expect: loss_share[deckout] small (<0.15); Sacred Ash fires when deckCount<=8 and >=3 Pokemon sit in discard
hypotheses.pattern: 山戻しカードの条件発火(deck<=N かつ トラッシュにPokemon>=M)

hypotheses.claim: The deck's only real attacker is the Alakazam line; Dunsparce/Dudunsparce colorless attacks (Ram 20, Land Crush 90) are off-plan and Dudunsparce is really a draw engine. A generic 'concentrate energy on best attacker' that reads Land Crush 90 > Powerful Hand 0 will feed energy to Dudunsparce and starve Alakazam.
hypotheses.expect: >=70% of Psychic energy attaches land on the Alakazam line; Dudunsparce/Dunsparce receive energy only as an emergency backup
hypotheses.violation_symptom: エネが意図しないポケモンへ
hypotheses.pattern: デッキ固有の給餌計画(Psychic は Alakazam 線へ; 実打点式で最良アタッカーを再定義)

hypotheses.claim: Evolution sequencing matters uniquely here: Psychic Draw (Kadabra draw2 / Alakazam draw3) triggers ON EVOLVE and puts cards into hand that then count for Powerful Hand. Evolving to Alakazam LAST in the turn banks +3 cards into the attack hand; evolving early and then playing those cards wastes them.
hypotheses.metric: sequence: fraction of turns where the final action before Powerful Hand is the Kadabra->Alakazam evolve
hypotheses.expect: on setup turns the last hand-growing play (evolve / Dudunsparce draw / Enriching) precedes the attack; hand not spent after the last draw
hypotheses.violation_symptom: スケール技の手札資源を先に吐く
hypotheses.pattern: シーケンス則: draw/evolve を攻撃直前に寄せる

hypotheses.claim: The deck is acutely vulnerable to opponent hand disruption (Marnie/Iono-type reset): Powerful Hand damage IS the hand, so a forced hand-refresh to a few cards collapses the turn's damage to near zero. The policy should, when disruption is anticipated or hand is small, rebuild hand (search/draw) before committing the attack rather than swinging into a whiffed Powerful Hand.
hypotheses.expect: after a low-hand turn the deck spends a turn re-drawing rather than attacking for <100; avoid PH attacks that fail to KO when a draw-then-attack next turn would KO
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 手札破壊でスケール技が崩壊
hypotheses.pattern: 低手札時は再ドロー優先(撃ち急ぎ抑制の均衡則を型スケール技に適用)

hypotheses.claim: Battle Cage(1264, stadium) protects the deck's fragile bench (Abra 50HP, Kadabra 80HP, Dunsparce 70HP) from opponent spread/snipe (damage-counter placement on bench). It is only relevant vs spread decks; against non-spread it is inert and playing it just occupies the stadium slot (could even remove a useful own stadium — there is none here, so low cost). Generic stadium play may drop it needlessly or fail to drop it when spread threatens the bench.
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[1264] conditioned on opponent spread threat
hypotheses.expect: Battle Cage played primarily when opponent has bench-damaging attacks/abilities; otherwise low play_rate
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 妨害/防御カードの浪費/腐り
hypotheses.pattern: 相手盤面条件(ベンチspread脅威)に限定したスタジアム設置

hypotheses.claim: First Powerful Hand can come as early as T2-T3 via Rare Candy(1079) Abra->Alakazam (skipping Kadabra, losing only Kadabra's draw2). But Rare Candy cannot be used T1 nor on a Pokemon put down this turn, so the earliest realistic online turn is player-turn 2. Speed vs a big enough hand is a tension the policy must balance (don't Rare Candy so early that hand is tiny).
hypotheses.expect: first Powerful Hand around player-turn 2-4 with hand>=7; not a turn-1-impossible / not routinely delayed past turn 5
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 速度と火力のトレードオフ誤り
hypotheses.pattern: オンライン判定を '手札>=閾値 かつ KO可能' に接地

743.name: Alakazam
743.trigger: primary attacker; evolve (via Rare Candy or from Kadabra) as the LAST hand-growing play of the turn, then Powerful Hand; Psychic Draw draws 3 into the attack hand

742.name: Kadabra
742.trigger: bridge; if not Rare-Candying, evolve Abra->Kadabra for Psychic Draw (+2) then next turn ->Alakazam; also a 30-dmg stopgap attacker if Alakazam unavailable

741.name: Abra
741.trigger: T1 Active/bench seed for the line; Teleportation Attack is an emergency free-switch, not a damage plan

1079.name: Rare Candy
1079.trigger: Abra->Alakazam skip when Alakazam in hand and Abra was in play from a prior turn; not T1; enables T2 Powerful Hand

1231.name: Dawn
1231.trigger: supporter (1/turn); fetch Basic+Stage1+Stage2 to assemble the whole Abra/Kadabra/Alakazam line in one card when the line is incomplete in hand

1225.name: Hilda
1225.trigger: supporter (1/turn); fetch an Evolution Pokemon + an Energy; net-adds 2 cards to hand (good for Powerful Hand) while completing the line

1086.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
1086.trigger: early; bench 2 basics <=70HP (Abra 50 / Dunsparce 70) to seed the evo line and Dudunsparce draw

1152.name: Poké Pad
1152.trigger: fetch any non-Rule-Box Pokemon (all our mons qualify) to hand; consistency filler that also net-adds a card

19.name: Telepath Psychic Energy
19.trigger: attach to a {P} body (Abra/Kadabra/Alakazam) to provide Psychic AND search 2 Basic {P} to bench; provides the Powerful Hand cost + develops board

5.name: Basic {P} Energy
5.trigger: attach 1 to the Alakazam line to pay Powerful Hand [5]; only ONE Psychic needed per attacker

1182.name: Boss's Orders
1182.trigger: supporter (1/turn); gust a benched target we can KO this turn (HP <= 20*hand) or a high-prize/support target; value keyed to Powerful Hand real formula, not 0

1097.name: Night Stretcher
1097.trigger: deck<=? or line disrupted; return a KO'd Alakazam/Abra or a Basic {P} energy from discard to rebuild the chain

66.name: Dudunsparce
66.trigger: draw engine: Run Away Draw only when hand<=4 AND it is not a needed energized body (it shuffles ITSELF back); Land Crush 90 is emergency backup attacker only

305.name: Dunsparce
305.trigger: bench body to evolve into Dudunsparce (draw engine); Trading Places free-switch; Ram 20 near-irrelevant

1081.name: Enhanced Hammer
1081.trigger: ONLY when opponent has a Special Energy attached; discard it (esp. before their attack); dead vs all-basic decks

13.name: Enriching Energy
13.trigger: attach for the draw-4; provides {C} only, so DO NOT rely on it to power Powerful Hand ([5]=Psychic). Feed to Dudunsparce/Dunsparce colorless costs or treat as a draw card

1184.name: Lana's Aid
1184.trigger: supporter; late/recovery: mass-return up to 3 (Alakazam-line Pokemon + Basic energy) from discard to rebuild after trades

1129.name: Sacred Ash
1129.trigger: deckCount<=8 AND >=3 Pokemon in discard: shuffle up to 5 Pokemon back to dodge deckout and refill the evo line

1264.name: Battle Cage
1264.trigger: stadium; drop when opponent threatens the bench with spread/snipe (damage-counter placement) to protect Abra/Kadabra; otherwise inert
